wearEvents.note: a hit taken: one in four wears one piece, picked by the slot weights
a kill: always wears one piece, picked by the slot weights

wearSlots.note: stands in for the sheet's neck: a necklace is not an armour slot

repairRules.note: town smith: a point costs more the more worn the piece is (slope), each repaired 100 points shave 2 off wearMax down to 60% of the original, and a worn-out piece still gives 40% of its quality, so gear never breaks to nothing
